spans.s: धौरितक n. (-कं) A horse's trot: see धोरितक.

धौरेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fit for burthen, capable of taking or bearing it,
(either a vehicle or a beast. &c.) m, (-यः)
 1. A beast of burthen.
2. A horse.
 E. धूर् a burthen, ढक् aff.

धौर्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a cheat, knavish, fraudulent
&c.
 n. (-कं) Fraud, dishonesty.
 E. धूर्त्त cheat, ठन् aff.

धौर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A horse's trot.
 E. धोर् to go well, affix ण्यत्.
